title: Inference VoC splice and probe lanes - runtime asks
content:
Purpose
-----
Quick synthesis of recent customer VoC (voice-of-customer) items that reference runtime behavior (latency, fallbacks, KV cache correctness, model switching). This is a lightweight, action-oriented docket intended for a 1-hour sync with product + runtime (week of 2026-09-06).

Snapshot headline (TL;DR)
-----------------------
- Three persistent customer asks across medium and enterprise: (1) predictable 95th/99th latency under burst traffic, (2) safer automatic fallback to quantized/cheaper variants without quality cliffs, (3) clearer tracing/attribution in Console for token-level cost/latency.
- Multiple requests tied to Dedicated/Private customers hitting region failovers and model-pin drift during canaries.
- Low-effort probes available: tweak routing policy to prefer local region hot-standby for 48h, expose per-request routing decision in logs, small KV-cache TTL tweak to validate cache-staleness hypothesis.

Top asks (ranked by frequency & customer impact)
------------------------------------------------
1) Predictable tail latency SLOs for interactive chat (95th/99th) under burst loads
   - Customers: fintech chatbot, large SaaS assistant, healthcare pilot.
   - Symptom: spikes during short bursts -> downstream app timeouts; seen when batching deferred or when KV cache cold.
   - Customer note snippets: "we can’t risk 5s tails during trades"; "UX jitter kills retention"
   - Suggested probes: simulate 10x traffic bursts in staging with same request mixes; enable fallback to smaller context-window instance.

2) Transparent, configurable fallback policies for model-cost tradeoffs
   - Ask: ability to declare a sequence: primary model -> degraded quantized model -> cached response -> 429/placeholder.
   - Why: customers want reduced cost but no sudden hallucination/regression when fallback happens.
   - Edge: request-level signal to prefer fidelity over cost for specific users (account tiers).

3) Better traceability: which route/region/model served each token + cost attribution
   - Console currently shows aggregate per-route; customers want end-to-end for debugging regressions.
   - Quick patch: add a request header echo and route id in response metadata in Dedicated + Private modes.

Representative vignettes (raw field notes)
------------------------------------------
- Fintech (large): high-frequency trading assistant, 99th = 3.2s in region-west during a 15-min burst. They keep a conservative 2s app timeout -> many soft-failures. Proposed temporary mitigation: local preference routing + smaller model fallback. (Jira: CUST-2147)

- Healthcare pilot: concerned about deterministic fallbacks — they want rollbackable traces for any fallback decision. They asked for signed audit entry when models are automatically switched. Customer quote: "If fallback happens, show us why and let us replay it."

- Adtech customer: heavy embedding traffic + unpredictable token billing spikes; wants clearer per-request token breakdown to reconcile invoices. They suspect retries are being double-charged.

Risk flags & unresolved hypotheses
----------------------------------
- Hypothesis A: KV-cache TTL default too aggressive for some workloads -> cold cache spikes. Need to validate by toggling TTL in staging.
- Hypothesis B: routing metric weights don't sufficiently prioritize local cached workers under burst -> more cross-region hops.
- Billing correlation gap: token attribution for streaming vs batched responses ambiguous in console.

Low-effort quick wins (48-72h engineer work)
-------------------------------------------
- Surface a per-response header: X-RW-Route-ID and X-RW-Model-Variant in Dedicated + Private (config toggle).
- Add traceable fallback event in request logs: fallback=true; from_model=...; to_model=...; reason=capacity|latency|error.
- Create a small smoke test that replays 1k mixed chat calls with cold cache and records 95/99 latencies; share baseline to customers.

Medium-effort changes (2-4 sprints)
-----------------------------------
- Rollout a policy UI in Console to manage fallback order per route (can be per-account).
- Add token-level billing breakdown to Console with mapping for streaming chunks vs final tokens.
- Improve routing policy heuristics to prefer hot-standby nodes and include simulated cost impact preview.

Open questions for the sync
--------------------------
- Which runtime owners want to own the fallback-log schema? (proposal: eng-serving-runtime)
- Is there appetite to make the per-request route header on by default for Dedicated customers? privacy/legal check?
- Can SRE run a scheduled 10x burst soak in staging and collect histograms for 95/99?

Proposed next steps (owner + due dates)
--------------------------------------
- Action: run TTL toggle experiment in staging + small burst test (owner: Ethan Chen) - target: 2026-09-09
- Action: PoC per-response header + fallback log events (owner: Priya Nair + eng-serving-runtime) - target: 2026-09-16
- Action: prepare customer-facing note explaining fallback semantics and safe-config patterns (owner: Lena Ortiz) - target: 2026-09-13

Notes to self / chase list
-------------------------
- Pull sample traces for CUST-2147 and annotate with model variant timeline.
- Confirm whether Private on-prem customers already have custom logging we can extend.
- Draft short FAQ: "What happens when a fallback is triggered?" + place in Console docs.

Appendix: raw signal snippets (unedited)
--------------------------------------
- "We see intermittent tails only when embedding and chat flows run concurrently in our region-east cluster. Could be hot node contention."
- "A fallback kicked in but we couldn't tell which model responded — the user saw garbled output and we couldn't reproduce locally."
- TODO: link to replay harness (https://internal-replays.redwood/inference/2026/091) 

End of doc
